mapper.select: SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY r.CREATE_DATE DESC , r.RECIPE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPES WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.RECIPE_NO NOT IN ( SELECT mat.RECIPE_NO FROM MATERIAL mat JOIN MEMBER_ALLERGY ma ON mat.MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' || ma.MATERIAL_NAME || '%' WHERE ma.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) ORDER BY r.CREATE_DATE DESC , r.RECIPE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPES r WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.RECIPE_NO NOT IN ( SELECT mat.RECIPE_NO FROM MATERIAL mat JOIN MEMBER_ALLERGY ma ON mat.MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' || ma.MATERIAL_NAME || '%' WHERE ma.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.RECIPE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY r.CREATE_DATE DESC , r.RECIPE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPES r WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.RECIPE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\'

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.RECIPE_NO NOT IN ( SELECT mat.RECIPE_NO FROM MATERIAL mat JOIN MEMBER_ALLERGY ma ON mat.MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' || ma.MATERIAL_NAME || '%' WHERE ma.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) AND r.RECIPE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY r.CREATE_DATE DESC , r.RECIPE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPES r WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.RECIPE_NO NOT IN ( SELECT mat.RECIPE_NO FROM MATERIAL mat JOIN MEMBER_ALLERGY ma ON mat.MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' || ma.MATERIAL_NAME || '%' WHERE ma.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) AND r.RECIPE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\'

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.MEMBER_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_INFO , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE , 0 AS IS_BOOKMARKED FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} AND r.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT RECIPE_NO , MEMBER_NO , RECIPE_TITLE , RECIPE_INFO , RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , RECIPES_IMG_PATH , CREATE_DATE , DEL_YN FROM RECIPES WHERE RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
